members.biography: Norub grew up in Iusususus, in an adoptive household. A patient older apprentice taught them the work of a traveller. Their household contributed to boatbuilding. They hope to pay a modest family debt; they still carry a stitched scrap of cloth.

members.biography: Raised in Iusususus, Taoka learned a working trade as a harbour worker, guided by a neighbour who taught evening lessons. Their grandparent household shared in boatbuilding. Leaving home, they hope to return a borrowed possession. A plain copper ring remains a reminder of that life.

members.biography: Dokmibu comes from a single-parent household in Iusususus. Their former work was that of a porter. In a community centred on boatbuilding, they learned from a neighbour who taught evening lessons. They carry a smoothed stone from a workbench and hope to seek work beyond familiar workshops.
